Gamepad

Connect a gamepad and press a button to enable.

Left stick or D-pad: move. Right stick left/right: rotate. A: shoot once. X: lower speed. Y: raise speed. Hold X/Y to adjust continuously.

Compatible gamepads use the browser Gamepad API. Button labels may vary by controller. Controls pause when this page loses focus.

Geometry & calibration

Base-mounted shooter: wheel center 6 in above the floor.

0.50 is an ideal rolling estimate for one wheel against a stationary hood, not a measured efficiency. Each ball type keeps its own ratio. Adjust using measured launch speed.

Changes the illustrated guide radius and release point. Its effect on grip and speed needs physical testing.

Guide cross-section

Not to scale with field

Rear is left; forward is right. Launch starts behind and above the wheel. Cyan: shortened hood, 124° wrap at the starting setting. Yellow: ball center path. The ball leaves at the selected angle above horizontal.

Physics assumptions

The preview and live flight use each ball’s diameter and mass: pollen 2.8 in / 24.95 g; nectar 3.6 in / 41.28 g. Gravity, air drag, rolling and collisions are modeled; spin lift and ball deformation are not.

The shooter assumes a 96 mm wheel, 1:1 drive and up to 6,000 RPM. Speed transfer, friction, bounce and drag are estimates; real shots need calibration. The preview follows the next loaded ball and its saved speed-transfer ratio.

Eight pollen or five nectar make one tipping load. Mixed loads add; loads on opposite sides subtract. Balls can spill when a hive tilts.
